title: Hardcoded application secret key — review required
description: A framework secret key (Flask/Django SECRET_KEY style) is assigned a quoted literal in source. The key signs sessions and tokens, so anyone with repository access can forge them until the key is rotated.
remediation: Load the secret key from an environment variable or secret manager at startup and fail closed when it is absent. Rotate the exposed value immediately.
limitation: Lexical: matches quoted literals only; keys from config files, vaults, or short placeholders never match. Whether the value is production or test-only needs human review.
